mapper.insert: INSERT INTO triage_record ( triage_id, patient_id, symptoms, recommendations, suggested_actions, mode, created_at ) VALUES ( #{record.triageId}, #{record.patientId}, CAST(#{record.symptoms} AS jsonb), CAST(#{record.recommendations} AS jsonb), CAST(#{record.suggestedActions} AS jsonb), #{record.mode}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT triage_id, patient_id, symptoms, recommendations, suggested_actions, mode, created_at FROM triage_record WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
